talents.name: Improved Gouge
talents.desc_rank1: Increases the duration of your Gouge ability by 0.5 sec.
talents.desc_max: Increases the duration of your Gouge ability by 1.5 sec.

talents.name: Remorseless Attacks
talents.desc_rank1: After killing a non-trivial enemy, gives you a 20% increased critical strike chance on your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Mutilate, or Ghostly Strike. Lasts 20 sec.
talents.desc_max: After killing a non-trivial enemy, gives you a 40% increased critical strike chance on your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Mutilate, or Ghostly Strike. Lasts 20 sec.

talents.name: Malice
talents.desc_rank1: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks and Poisons by 1%.
talents.desc_max: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks and Poisons by 5%.

talents.name: Ruthlessness
talents.desc_rank1: Gives your finishing moves a 20% chance to add a Combo Point to your target.
talents.desc_max: Gives your finishing moves a 60% chance to add a Combo Point to your target.

talents.name: Improved Expose Armor
talents.desc_rank1: Reduces the Energy cost of your Expose Armor ability by 5, and refunds 1 Combo Point when cast with 5 Combo Points.
talents.desc_max: Reduces the Energy cost of your Expose Armor ability by 10, and refunds 2 Combo Points when cast with 5 Combo Points.

talents.name: Improved Slice and Dice
talents.desc_rank1: Increases the duration of your Slice and Dice ability by 15%.
talents.desc_max: Increases the duration of your Slice and Dice ability by 45%.

talents.name: Vigor
talents.desc_rank1: Increases your maximum Energy by 5.
talents.desc_max: Increases your maximum Energy by 10.

talents.name: Blood Splatter
talents.desc_rank1: Increases the duration of your Rupture ability by 6 sec and your Garrote ability by 9 sec.
talents.desc_max: Increases the duration of your Rupture ability by 6 sec and your Garrote ability by 9 sec.

talents.name: Lethality
talents.desc_rank1: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Sinister Strike, Gouge, Backstab, Mutilate, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities by 10%.
talents.desc_max: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Sinister Strike, Gouge, Backstab, Mutilate, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities by 20%.

talents.name: Vile Poisons
talents.desc_rank1: Increases the damage dealt by your poisons by 4% and gives your poisons an additional 8% chance to resist dispel effects.
talents.desc_max: Increases the damage dealt by your poisons by 20% and gives your poisons an additional 40% chance to resist dispel effects.

talents.name: Cold Blood
talents.desc_rank1: When activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate, or Mutilate by 100%.
talents.desc_max: When activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate, or Mutilate by 100%.

talents.name: Improved Poisons
talents.desc_rank1: Increases the chance to apply Poisons to your target by 2%, and gives Poison applications a 10% chance to not consume a charge.
talents.desc_max: Increases the chance to apply Poisons to your target by 10%, and gives Poison applications a 50% chance to not consume a charge.

talents.name: Relentless Strikes
talents.desc_rank1: Your finishing moves have a 4% chance per Combo Point to restore 25 Energy.
talents.desc_max: Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per Combo Point to restore 25 Energy.

talents.name: Venom
talents.desc_rank1: Causes your Shank ability to increase your Poison damage by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 20% for 6 sec.
talents.desc_max: Causes your Shank ability to increase your Poison damage by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 20% for 6 sec.

talents.name: Improved Kidney Shot
talents.desc_rank1: Enemies Stunned by your Kidney Shot ability take 5% increased damage from your poisons and attacks.
talents.desc_max: Enemies Stunned by your Kidney Shot ability take 10% increased damage from your poisons and attacks.

talents.name: Seal Fate
talents.desc_rank1: Your critical strikes from abilities that add Combo Points have a 33% chance to add an additional Combo Point.
talents.desc_max: Your critical strikes from abilities that add Combo Points have a 100% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

talents.name: Mutilate
talents.desc_rank1: Instantly attacks with both weapons for 90% weapon damage plus an additional 40 with each weapon. Damage increased by 20% against Poisoned targets. Awards 2 Combo Points.
talents.desc_max: Instantly attacks with both weapons for 90% weapon damage plus an additional 40 with each weapon. Damage increased by 20% against Poisoned targets. Awards 2 Combo Points.

talents.name: Coup de Grace
talents.desc_rank1: Increases the damage done by your Eviscerate ability by 7%, and the damage and storage rate of your Death Mark ability by 7%.
talents.desc_max: Increases the damage done by your Eviscerate ability by 20%, and the damage and storage rate of your Death Mark ability by 20%.

talents.name: Efficient Strikes
talents.desc_rank1: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sinister Strike and Hemorrhage abilities by 3.
talents.desc_max: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sinister Strike and Hemorrhage abilities by 5.

talents.name: Lightning Reflexes
talents.desc_rank1: Increases your Dodge chance by 1%.
talents.desc_max: Increases your Dodge chance by 5%.

talents.name: Puncturing Wounds
talents.desc_rank1: Increases the critical strike chance of your Backstab by 10% and your Mutilate by 5%, and gives Backstab a 15% chance to add an additional Combo Point.
talents.desc_max: Increases the critical strike chance of your Backstab by 30% and your Mutilate by 15%, and gives Backstab a 45% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

talents.name: Deflection
talents.desc_rank1: Increases your Parry chance by 2%.
talents.desc_max: Increases your Parry chance by 6%.

talents.name: Precision
talents.desc_rank1: Improves your chance to hit by 1%.
talents.desc_max: Improves your chance to hit by 3%.

talents.name: Improved Sprint
talents.desc_rank1: Gives a 50% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when you activate your Sprint ability.
talents.desc_max: Gives a 100% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when you activate your Sprint ability.

talents.name: Endurance
talents.desc_rank1: Reduces the cooldown of your Sprint and Evasion abilities by 30%.
talents.desc_max: Reduces the cooldown of your Sprint and Evasion abilities by 60%.

talents.name: Riposte
talents.desc_rank1: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 150% weapon damage and disarms the target for 6 sec.
talents.desc_max: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 150% weapon damage and disarms the target for 6 sec.

talents.name: Composure
talents.desc_rank1: Increases the Energy cost reduction of your Poised ability by 5.
talents.desc_max: Increases the Energy cost reduction of your Poised ability by 10.

talents.name: Improved Kick
talents.desc_rank1: Gives your Kick ability a 50% chance to Silence the target for 2 sec.
talents.desc_max: Gives your Kick ability a 100% chance to Silence the target for 2 sec.

talents.name: Flawless Execution
talents.desc_rank1: Reduces the Energy cost of your Eviscerate ability by 15.
talents.desc_max: Reduces the Energy cost of your Eviscerate ability by 15.

talents.name: Weapon Expertise
talents.desc_rank1: Reduces the chance for your attacks to be Dodged or Parried by 1%.
talents.desc_max: Reduces the chance for your attacks to be Dodged or Parried by 2%.

talents.name: Aggression
talents.desc_rank1: Increases the damage of your Sinister Strike and Eviscerate abilities by 5%.
talents.desc_max: Increases the damage of your Sinister Strike and Eviscerate abilities by 15%.

talents.name: Dual Wield Specialization
talents.desc_rank1: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 25%.
talents.desc_max: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 50%.

talents.name: Blade Flurry
talents.desc_rank1: Increases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec.
talents.desc_max: Increases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec.

talents.name: Hack and Slash
talents.desc_rank1: Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon. Axe/Sword: Your successful melee attacks have a 1% chance to trigger an extra attack on the target. Dagger/Fist: Increases your critical strike chance by 1%. Mace: Your attacks ignore 3% of your target's armor.
talents.desc_max: Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon. Axe/Sword: Your successful melee attacks have a 5% chance to trigger an extra attack on the target. Dagger/Fist: Increases your critical strike chance by 5%. Mace: Your attacks ignore 15% of your target's armor.

talents.name: Flash of Steel
talents.desc_rank1: Increases the Energy generated by your Shank ability by 3 and reduces its cooldown by 0.4 sec.
talents.desc_max: Increases the Energy generated by your Shank ability by 15 and reduces its cooldown by 2 sec.

talents.name: Adrenaline Rush
talents.desc_rank1: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec.
talents.desc_max: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec.

talents.name: Setup
talents.desc_rank1: Gives you a 15% chance to add a Combo Point to your target after Dodging their attack or fully resisting one of their spells.
talents.desc_max: Gives you a 45% chance to add a Combo Point to your target after Dodging their attack or fully resisting one of their spells.

talents.name: Master of Deception
talents.desc_rank1: Reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while in Stealth mode as if you were 1 level higher.
talents.desc_max: Reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while in Stealth mode as if you were 3 levels higher.

talents.name: Opportunity
talents.desc_rank1: Increases the damage dealt by your Backstab, Garrote, Ambush, and Mutilate abilities by 4%.
talents.desc_max: Increases the damage dealt by your Backstab, Garrote, Ambush, and Mutilate abilities by 20%.

talents.name: Dirty Deeds
talents.desc_rank1: Reduces the Energy cost of your Cheap Shot and Garrote abilities by 10, and your Garrote ability no longer requires you to be behind your target.
talents.desc_max: Reduces the Energy cost of your Cheap Shot and Garrote abilities by 20, and your Garrote ability no longer requires you to be behind your target.

talents.name: Camouflage
talents.desc_rank1: Reduces your speed penalty from your Stealth ability by 5% and reduces its cooldown by 2 sec.
talents.desc_max: Reduces your speed penalty from your Stealth ability by 15% and reduces its cooldown by 6 sec.

talents.name: Improved Ambush
talents.desc_rank1: Increases the critical strike chance of your Ambush ability by 15%.
talents.desc_max: Increases the critical strike chance of your Ambush ability by 45%.

talents.name: Dirty Tricks
talents.desc_rank1: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sap and Blind abilities by 25%.
talents.desc_max: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sap and Blind abilities by 50%.

talents.name: Initiative
talents.desc_rank1: Gives you a 33% chance to add an additional combo point to your target when using your Ambush, Garrote, or Cheap Shot ability.
talents.desc_max: Gives you a 100% chance to add an additional combo point to your target when using your Ambush, Garrote, or Cheap Shot ability.

talents.name: Premeditation
talents.desc_rank1: Adds 2 Combo Points to your target. You must add to or use those combo points within 20 sec or the combo points are lost.
talents.desc_max: Adds 2 Combo Points to your target. You must add to or use those combo points within 20 sec or the combo points are lost.

talents.name: Serrated Blades
talents.desc_rank1: Causes your attacks to ignore 3% of your target's Armor and increases the damage dealt by your Rupture ability by 10%.
talents.desc_max: Causes your attacks to ignore 9% of your target's Armor and increases the damage dealt by your Rupture ability by 30%.

talents.name: Elusiveness
talents.desc_rank1: Reduces the cooldown of your Vanish and Blind abilities by 45 sec.
talents.desc_max: Reduces the cooldown of your Vanish and Blind abilities by 90 sec.

talents.name: Ghostly Strike
talents.desc_rank1: A strike that deals 125% (180% if a Dagger is equipped in your Main Hand) weapon damage, increases your chance to dodge by 15% for 7 sec, and causes your next Ambush or Garrote cast within 7 sec to not require Stealth. Awards 1 combo point.
talents.desc_max: A strike that deals 125% (180% if a Dagger is equipped in your Main Hand) weapon damage, increases your chance to dodge by 15% for 7 sec, and causes your next Ambush or Garrote cast within 7 sec to not require Stealth. Awards 1 combo point.

talents.name: Quick Getaway
talents.desc_rank1: Increases the maximum number of targets you may have Sapped by 1, and increases your movement speed by 15% for 3 sec after Sapping a target.
talents.desc_max: Increases the maximum number of targets you may have Sapped by 1, and increases your movement speed by 30% for 3 sec after Sapping a target.

talents.name: Heightened Senses
talents.desc_rank1: Increases your Stealth detection as if you were 1 level higher and reduces your chance to be hit by spells and ranged attacks by 2%.
talents.desc_max: Increases your Stealth detection as if you were 3 levels higher and reduces your chance to be hit by spells and ranged attacks by 4%.

talents.name: Preparation
talents.desc_rank1: When activated, this ability immediately finishes the cooldown on your other Rogue abilities.
talents.desc_max: When activated, this ability immediately finishes the cooldown on your other Rogue abilities.

talents.name: Hemorrhage
talents.desc_rank1: An instant strike that deals 100% weapon damage (145% if a Dagger is equipped) and causes the target to take 15% increased Rupture and Garrote damage from the Rogue. Lasts 15 sec. Awards 1 Combo Point.
talents.desc_max: An instant strike that deals 100% weapon damage (145% if a Dagger is equipped) and causes the target to take 15% increased Rupture and Garrote damage from the Rogue. Lasts 15 sec. Awards 1 Combo Point.

talents.name: Boot Knife
talents.desc_rank1: Grants your Shank ability a 20% chance to add 2 Combo Points to the target.
talents.desc_max: Grants your Shank ability a 100% chance to add 2 Combo Points to the target.

talents.desc_rank1: Finishing move that marks the target, storing a portion of the damage dealt by your attacks per Combo Point. Garrote and Rupture damage is stored at twice the rate.
